items.note: The overview names the product as a B2B note-taking app, and the requirements fit a B2B team tool.
The header names engineering and design leads as the audience and says the purpose is the kickoff.
All three capabilities (create a workspace, invite members by email, shared notes) are listed in scope and each has its own requirements section (5.1–5.3).
The roles table has only admin and member, and the text says only these two roles exist in v1.
Billing changes, SSO and guest access are listed as out of scope. The doc repeats this in 5.2 and names them as scope-pressure risks.
The metric is stated exactly as given. The proposed definition of when the 60-day window starts is clearly marked as proposed, not decided.
The doc is about 950–1,050 words with compact sections and lists, which fits roughly 2 pages.
Migration is listed as an open question, says outright that no recommended answer is given, and lists what a decision would need to cover without deciding it.
